actions.preconditions: The mind believes an adjacent grid cell exists and is passable.
actions.effect: Relocate to an adjacent patch; present physical cues update for the new cell and its neighbours.

actions.preconditions: The mind believes a patch is reachable (on or adjacent) and not yet inspected this epoch.
actions.effect: Add targeted physical cues for the chosen patch; beliefs about yield may update from the observation.

actions.preconditions: The mind stands on the patch and believes gathering is possible there.
actions.effect: Draw food units from the patch true yield, apply hunger relief, mark the patch visited (remembered).
No state change beyond epoch advance.
